biomarker_unit: serum concentration; mRNA levels; expression levels
disease_details: Anorexia nervosa, restricting type; Anorexia nervosa, binge-eating/purging type
feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively

feces_phenotype: Gut microbiota composition; Bacterial taxa abundance; Viral microbiota diversity; Structural variants in bacteria
feces_phenotype_value: altered bacterial composition at phylum level with reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota; higher β-diversity at genus and species level; higher prevalence of Ruminococcacea-enterotype (R-enterotype); 85 overlapping amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) between human donors and GF mouse recipients; 45 (53%) altered ASVs in donors transferred to recipients; 31 conserved metabolites between human donors and mouse recipients; alterations of 19 of 31 (61%) transferred metabolites from human to mouse; higher viral richness (Chao1) and diversity (Shannon) in AN; 219 viral–bacterial interactions in HC versus 84 in AN; 31 viral species enriched or decreased in AN; 25 of 30 increased viral species in AN were Lactococcus phages
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: 77 female AN cases with DSM-5 diagnosis; 70 age-matched healthy female controls; Danish Caucasian women only; recruited September 2014 to July 2016; Exclusion: antibiotics/antifungals within 3 months, acute/chronic somatic diseases or infections; Controls: BMI 18.5-25 kg/m², no regular medications except birth control, no antibiotics within 3 months; AN cases: restricting (AN-RS) subtype (n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP) subtype (n=21); Inpatients received safe weight restoration at 2.0-3.0% per week under multidisciplinary care; Outpatients received individual diet plans with 40-50% carbohydrate, 30-40% fat, 20-25% protein; Shotgun metagenomics performed on fecal samples; metabolomics on serum samples; FMT experiments: germ-free Swiss Webster mice colonized with fecal samples from 3 AN cases and 3 healthy controls; Mice underwent 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks to mimic AN eating behavior; 6-week-old female germ-free mice; 8, 6, and 6 littermates per litter respectively
